Do these as separate shell tool calls, one command per call, in order, each command exactly as written, whatever happens: 1) i=0; while [ $i -lt 2 ]; do echo "w$i"; i=$((i+1)); done 2) case x in x) echo matched;; *) echo no;; esac 3) true; echo "status $?" 4) [[ -f in.txt ]] && echo exists 5) cat <<-EOF
	tab body
	EOF
6) cat <<< "here string" 7) for f in *.txt; do echo "$f"; done 8) set -- p q; echo $1 $@ 9) until true; do :; done; echo done 10) x=$(echo a | tr a b) && echo "$x". Then reply only DONE.
</user_query>
